title: ModelCall
description: A model call's durable binding (docs/design/m1/00-slice-plan.md P12a; 03 "External effects"; 05 "Usage and settlement"): the call to its attempt, the attempt's lease, and the resource groups that lease reserves on. It is the request of the call's model_call effect, and the payload of the model_call.intended event that commits with that intent, before the gateway sends anything for the call. A call is bound once: its binding never changes. Recovery reads it to keep an uncertain call's charge on its groups.

call.description: The call-ledger id; its model_call effect has the same suffix under eff_.

attempt.description: The attempt the call is made for, the one its lease is running.

destination.description: The registry's destination for that executor. The intent's target is the call, never the destination, so calls to one destination are separate targets.

groups.description: The groups of the lease's reservations, sorted: where the call's usage, or its liability, is charged.
